name: version-command
body: kalide exposes its build-stamped version to users: `kalide version` (and `--version`/`-v` accepted as a top-level flag equivalent) prints the version string stamped at build time via `-ldflags -X main.version=...` (`dev` for unbuilt/source runs) to stdout and exits 0. This reverses the prior "no user-facing surface" design for the `version` variable in `cmd/kalide/main.go` — see the reconciliation note — while leaving the build-time stamping mechanism itself unchanged. AC: `kalide version` and `kalide --version` each print exactly one line containing the stamped version (or `dev`) and exit 0; a release binary built with `-ldflags "-X main.version=vX.Y.Z"` prints `vX.Y.Z`.
